integrity: The proof is symbolic for every integer m at least 2. It uses an exhaustive vertex description of an explicit finite-dimensional absolute norm, a common-facet argument, the established P3 property of c0, and a direct norm estimate for an (m+1)-slice obstruction. No numerical sampling, timeout, or computational certificate is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The construction separates consecutive finite arities only for the sphere-intersection property P3. It does not establish the analogous P2 hierarchy, classify all separating spaces, or prove optimality of the quantitative bad-combination radius. Because the focal preprint is recent, an equivalent generalization under different finite-arity or diameter-two terminology remains a residual originality risk.
title: Strictness at every finite arity for sphere-intersecting slice combinations
